rules.message: System back gesture disabled, hidden, or handled the deprecated way.
rules.fix: Keep edge-swipe back on iOS and predictive back on Android. Guard only real data loss (PopScope, OnBackPressedCallback, usePreventRemove) and say why.

rules.message: Hamburger menu or navigation drawer. It hides the top destinations behind a tap.
rules.fix: Ask first. Use tabs for three to five peer destinations; keep a drawer only for many destinations or a large-screen rail.

rules.message: Hover behavior in a touch app. Nobody hovers on a phone.
rules.fix: Make the information or control visible without hover, or guard it with @media (hover: hover) for pointer devices only.

rules.message: Screen with a text input and no keyboard handling. The keyboard may cover the field.
rules.fix: Use KeyboardAvoidingView, automaticallyAdjustKeyboardInsets, or imePadding, and set keyboardShouldPersistTaps. Check it on a small phone.

rules.message: Safe area ignored. Content may sit under the notch or home indicator.
rules.fix: Ignore the safe area for backgrounds only, e.g. .background(Color.surface.ignoresSafeArea()).
